e.title: **从零手写的链梯，先用库核对到零差、再用**真实后续发展**回测**：仓库 `ishimwe07/loss-reserving-chainladder`——**⭐ 与已收录的 [[chainladder-python]] **十年终极损失逐年完全一致、**最大差为 0****（**并有断言**）；**⭐ 而回测给出的不是好消息**：**十年里**每一年都偏小、**没有一年偏大**——**⭐ 自述**「**That is systematic bias, not noise**」**；**⚠️ 无 `LICENSE`**、**★0**
e.title_en: A chain-ladder implementation written from scratch in pandas that first reconciles to zero difference against a pooled reserving library and then backtests against nine further years of real development, where every accident year turns out to have been under-projected and none over-projected, a pattern the readme calls systematic bias rather than noise.
e.title_hk: **從零手寫的鏈梯，先用庫核對到零差、再用**真實後續發展**回測**：倉庫 `ishimwe07/loss-reserving-chainladder`——**⭐ 與已收錄的 [[chainladder-python]] **十年終極損失逐年完全一致、**最大差為 0****（**並有斷言**）**；**⭐ 而回測給出的不是好消息**：**十年裡**每一年都偏小、**沒有一年偏大**——**⭐ 自述**「**That is systematic bias, not noise**」**；**⚠️ 無 `LICENSE`**、**★0**
e.summary: **loss-reserving-chainladder**（`ishimwe07/loss-reserving-chainladder`）**是一份**从零手写的链梯准备金实现**，**逐字自述为**「**Chain-ladder reserving on a US personal auto portfolio, implemented from scratch in pandas, validated against `chainladder-python` and backtested against nine years of subsequent development.**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-08-17、最后推送 2026-09-08**、**★0**、**主语言 Python**；**tarball 20 条路径**（**六个 `src/` 模块、**一个测试文件、**数据 `data/ppauto.csv` 已随仓库提供**）**；**⚠️ 无 `LICENSE`**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**下游：拿上游当尺子**」**——**它把已收录的 [[chainladder-python]] 当**核对基准****（**逐字**「**Identical ultimates to `chainladder-python` — maximum difference across all ten years is zero.**」**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三处最值得看**：**① **库核对到**零差**（**⭐ 即**「**我写得对**」有量化证明**）**；**② **再用**真实后续发展**回测**（**截至二〇一六年**），**并如实报出**每一年都偏小****（**准备金 **2.5% 不足****，**⭐ 且**误差随不成熟度放大**）**；**③ **把数据选择的理由写明**（**单一公司而非行业合计、**已付而非已发生**）。**⚠️ 本次未运行其代码。
e.summary_hk: **loss-reserving-chainladder**（`ishimwe07/loss-reserving-chainladder`）**是一份**從零手寫的鏈梯準備金實現**，**逐字自述為**「**Chain-ladder reserving on a US personal auto portfolio, implemented from scratch in pandas, validated against `chainladder-python` and backtested against nine years of subsequent development.**」**。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-08-17、最後推送 2026-09-08**、**★0**、**Python**；**tarball 20 條路徑**（**六個 `src/` 模組、**一個測試檔、**資料 `data/ppauto.csv` 隨倉庫提供**）**；**⚠️ 無 `LICENSE`**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**下游：拿上游當尺子**」**——**它把已收錄的 [[chainladder-python]] 當**核對基準****（**逐字**「**Identical ultimates to `chainladder-python` — maximum difference across all ten years is zero.**」**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三處最值得看**：**① **庫核對到**零差****；**② **再用**真實後續發展**回測**（**截至二〇一六年**），**並如實報出**每一年都偏小****（**準備金 **2.5% 不足****，**誤差隨不成熟度放大**）**；**③ **把資料選擇的理由寫明**（**單一公司而非行業合計、**已付而非已發生**）。**⚠️ 本次未運行其代碼。
e.summary_en: The repository loss-reserving-chainladder **is a chain-ladder reserving implementation written from scratch in pandas**, described verbatim as chain-ladder reserving on a United States personal auto portfolio, implemented from scratch in pandas, validated against a pooled reserving library and backtested against nine years of subsequent development. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-08-17**, **last pushed 2026-09-08**, **zero stars**, primarily Python, **twenty paths in the extracted archive** with six source modules, one test file and the data file committed, and **no licence file**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the downstream using the upstream as a yardstick**, since it uses the pooled reserving library as its reconciliation baseline and states verbatim that it produces identical ultimates with a maximum difference of zero across all ten accident years. **Three things are worth reading**: the reconciliation to zero difference gives a quantified proof that the implementation is correct; a backtest against nine further years of real development then reports honestly that every accident year was under-projected, with the reserve about two and a half percent short and the error growing with immaturity; and the reasons for the data choices are written down, including a single company rather than an industry aggregate because chain ladder assumes a stable development pattern which an industry blend does not have, and paid rather than incurred losses because incurred losses fall over time as case reserves are released. **Nothing was run this round.**
e.body:
**loss-reserving-chainladder**（GitHub 仓库 `ishimwe07/loss-reserving-chainladder`）**是一份**从零手写的链梯准备金实现**，**README 逐字自述为**「**Chain-ladder reserving on a US personal auto portfolio, implemented from scratch in pandas, validated against `chainladder-python` and backtested against nine years of subsequent development.**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-08-17、最后推送 2026-09-08**、**★0**、**主语言 Python**；**tarball 20 条路径**；**⚠️ 无 `LICENSE`**（**⭐ 本词条按惯例记为**权利不明**）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**下游：拿上游当尺子**」**——**它把本站已收录的 [[chainladder-python]] 当作**核对基准****。

**可核实信息（均 README 与文件清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把「**我算得对**」变成了一个可量化的核对结果**——**逐字**：**「**Identical ultimates to `chainladder-python` — maximum difference across all ten years is zero. Asserted in `tests/test_chainladder.py`.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**先用**已收录的库**把自写实现钉住**（**十年、**十个事故年、**最大差 **0**）**，**而不是**用「**结果看起来合理**」来判断对错**；**⭐ 这与本站第 348 轮「**自验证**」、第 344 轮「**把依据放在看得见的地方**」同向**：**核对基准是被指名道姓写出来的**（**且**有断言**）。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 而它随后给出的**不是一个好消息**——**逐字**：**「**The pattern matters more than the headline. Every accident year is under-projected; not one overshoots. That is systematic bias, not noise, and the error scales with immaturity — mature years land within 0.1%, the least developed miss by ~0.6%.**」**。**⭐ 本次实测到的关键数字**：**截至 2007 年末的准备金估计为 **13,122,496**（**README 概称 $13.12M****）**，**而**到二〇一六年**实际所需为 **13,458,704**（**⭐ 即**准备金**不足约 2.5%****）**；**终极损失合计**估计 **114,523,246**、**实际 **114,859,454**、**差 **336,208**（**即 **0.29%****）**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处比「**核对到零差**」更有价值**：**⭐ 它把**「**算法实现正确**」与**「**方法本身有系统偏差**」这两件事分开了**——**⭐ 即**你的代码可以**完全正确**，**而你的准备金仍然**年复一年地偏小**。**⭐⭐ ③ 它指出了**偏差的机制**，**而不只是报一个数**——**逐字**：**「**The cause is that the later factors rest on very few observations: `f_9` is estimated from accident year 1998 alone, and it understates what later years went on to show. The comparison is made at lag 10, so it excludes development beyond the triangle; since `f_9` is still 1.0017, the true deficiency is somewhat worse.**」**。**⭐ 即**偏差来自**末端发展因子只有一条观测**；**⭐ 而它进一步说明**比对只做到第 10 个滞后**，**故**真实缺口**比 2.5% 还要更差一些**——**⭐ 本词条认为**「**我报的这个偏差本身就是低估**」**这一句很少见，**值得抄**。**⭐⭐ ④ 数据选择的每一条都带理由**——**逐字三条**：**① **一家公司、不是行业合计**（**「**One company, not the industry aggregate — chain-ladder assumes a stable development pattern, which an industry blend does not have.**」**）**；**② **用已付、不用已发生**（**「**Paid, not incurred — incurred losses fall over time here as case reserves are released, producing link ratios below 1.0.**」**）**；**③ **切在 2007 估值日**（**「**Cut at the 2007 valuation — the raw dataset is a full square including actuals through 2016. Filtering recreates the real forecasting problem; the discarded portion becomes the backtest.**」**）**。**⭐ 本题库认为第 ③ 条尤其实用**：**⭐ 即**把完整方阵**切掉一部分**，**让剩下的部分**充当回测**——**⭐ 这与本站第 356 轮那条「**注册在前、**结果在后**」是同一件事的两种做法**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 局限被逐条列出，**且包含**对结论的修正方向****——**逐字四条**：**无尾部因子**（**第 10 个滞后之后按 1.0 处理**）**；**2007 事故年**杠杆极高**（**一个数据点 × CDF **2.2382**，**承载一半的准备金 6,643,130**）**；**链梯在**理赔处理速度变化、**单一大额损失、**案均准备金强度变化**时会退化**；**以及**Bornhuetter-Ferguson 会缓解不成熟年的杠杆，**但本项目**未实现****。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 工程形态可数**：`src/` **六个模块逐字为** `triangle.py`（**原始记录 → 累计三角**）、`vol_weighted_factors.py`（**逐龄发展因子**）、`cumulative_dev_factors.py`（**CDF**）、`chain_ladder.py`（**终极值与准备金**）、`backtest.py`（**预测 vs 实际发展**）、`plots.py`；**`main.py` 一条命令跑完三角、**准备金、**回测与出图**（**逐字** `python main.py`）**；**`pytest` 用于对库核对**；**⭐ 并逐字写明**「**Data is committed, so the repo runs as cloned.**」**——**⭐ 即**克隆即可跑**，**不必先找数据**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[chainladder-python]] 覆盖官方 Python 准备金库**，**[[actuarial-reserving]]、**[[reserving-ml]]、**[[ibnr-app]]、**[[gi-loss-reserving]] 覆盖链梯／BF／Cape Cod 的多种实现**，**[[loss-reserving-engine]] 覆盖「**先造数据再清洗再建三角**」的流水线**，**[[motor-loss-reserving-dl]] 覆盖车险的经典方法与深度学习对比**，**[[hgr-hidden-grammar-reserving]] 覆盖方法与输出纪律**，**[[verified-reserving]] 覆盖形式化证明**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**先用库核对到零差、**再用真实后续发展回测、**并把系统性偏差的成因与低估方向写出来**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[chainladder-python]]、[[reserving-ml]] 应当并读**——**前者给库，**中者给教学实现，**本条给**「**实现正确 ≠ 估计无偏**」这一课**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的三点**：**① 自写实现先用**已收录的库**核对，**并把最大差写出来**；**② 用**切掉一部分完整数据**的方式造回测**；**③ 当结果**系统性偏一个方向**时，**去找**哪一步只靠了极少数观测**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有运行该项目任何一步**（**未装依赖、**未跑 `main.py`、**未跑 `pytest`、**未复算任何发展因子或 CDF**），**故**不主张**其准备金数字、**不主张**其与库的零差结论、**不主张**其回测的百分比**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何源码正文**——**本次只读** `README.md` **与 tarball 路径列表**；**未打开** `src/` **下六个模块、**`main.py`、**`tests/test_chainladder.py`，**也**未读** `data/ppauto.csv`。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实** `data/ppauto.csv` **是否确为 CAS Loss Reserve Database（美国 Schedule P）** 的**某一家公司、**某一段事故年**的切片**（**⭐ 本词条只转述 README 的说法**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实该公司的名称是否确为 README 所述的 State Farm Mutual Group**；**⭐ 本词条按 README 转述，**并提示**该数据集的引用与使用条款**本次**未核实**。**⑤ ⚠️ **权利不明**：**仓库内未见 `LICENSE`，**README 亦未逐字给出许可条款****（**⭐ 这**不等于**作者放弃权利**）**；**⚠️ 复用其代码或数字前须先取得作者许可**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实作者身份与机构**；**★0、**无 CI、**仅一个测试文件**——**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**这是一个**个人练习级**仓库**，**其价值在**做法**而不在**可作为生产工具**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实 README 中「**$13.12M**」与表中 **13,122,496** 的对应关系**（**⭐ 两处均来自 README，**本词条分开引用而未替它调和**）**。**⑧ ⚠️ 创建 2026-08-17 在解冻窗口之外、推送 2026-09-08 在窗口之内**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是「**先用已收录库核对到零差、**再用真实后续发展回测、**并把系统性偏差的机制与**低估方向**写出来**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**本条目的任何数字**都只是**该项目在其自有数据上的自述结果**，**不得**用于任何真实的准备金判断**。

**loss-reserving-chainladder**（GitHub 倉庫 `ishimwe07/loss-reserving-chainladder`）**是一份**從零手寫的鏈梯準備金實現**，**README 逐字自述為**「**Chain-ladder reserving on a US personal auto portfolio, implemented from scratch in pandas, validated against `chainladder-python` and backtested against nine years of subsequent development.**」**。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-08-17、最後推送 2026-09-08**、**★0**、**Python**；**tarball 20 條路徑**；**⚠️ 無 `LICENSE`**（**按慣例記為**權利不明**）**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**下游：拿上游當尺子**」**——**它把已收錄的 [[chainladder-python]] 當作**核對基準****。

**可核實資訊（均 README 與文件清單實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把「**我算得對**」變成可量化的核對結果**——**逐字**「**Identical ultimates to `chainladder-python` — maximum difference across all ten years is zero. Asserted in `tests/test_chainladder.py`.**」**。**⭐ 本詞條認為這是本輪最值得抄的一處**：**先用**已收錄的庫**把自寫實現釘住**（**十年、**最大差 **0**）**，**而不是**靠「**結果看起來合理**」**；**⭐ 這與本站第 348 輪「**自驗證**」同向**：**核對基準被指名道姓寫出來**，**且有斷言**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 而它隨後給出的**不是好消息****——**逐字**「**Every accident year is under-projected; not one overshoots. That is systematic bias, not noise, and the error scales with immaturity — mature years land within 0.1%, the least developed miss by ~0.6%.**」**。**⭐ 實測到的關鍵數字**：**截至 2007 年末準備金估計 **13,122,496**，**而**到二〇一六年**實際所需 **13,458,704**（**不足約 2.5%****）**；**終極損失合計**估計 **114,523,246**、**實際 **114,859,454**、**差 **336,208**（**0.29%****）**。**⭐ 本詞條認為這一處比「**核對到零差**」更有價值**：**它把「**算法實現正確**」與「**方法本身有系統偏差**」分開了**——**⭐ 即**代碼可以**完全正確**，**準備金仍**年年偏小****。**⭐⭐ ③ 它指出**偏差的機制****——**逐字**「**`f_9` is estimated from accident year 1998 alone, and it understates what later years went on to show. The comparison is made at lag 10, so it excludes development beyond the triangle; since `f_9` is still 1.0017, the true deficiency is somewhat worse.**」**——**⭐ 即**「**我報的這個偏差本身就是低估**」**，**值得抄**。**⭐⭐ ④ 資料選擇每條都帶理由**：**一家公司而非行業合計**（**鏈梯假設發展模式穩定，**行業混合沒有**）**、**用已付而非已發生**（**案均準備金釋放會讓已發生損失下降，**使 link ratio 低於 1.0**）**、**切在 2007 估值日**（**完整方陣切掉一部分，**剩下的充當回測**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 局限逐條列出，**並含**對結論的修正方向****：**無尾部因子**、**2007 事故年槓桿極高**（**一個資料點 × CDF **2.2382**，**承載一半準備金 6,643,130**）**、**鏈梯在理賠處理速度變化／單一大額損失／案均準備金強度變化**時退化**、**Bornhuetter-Ferguson 未實現**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 工程形態可數**：`src/` **六個模組**（triangle／vol_weighted_factors／cumulative_dev_factors／chain_ladder／backtest／plots**）**、`main.py` 一條命令跑完（**逐字** `python main.py`**）**、`pytest` 對庫核對**，**並逐字寫明**「**Data is committed, so the repo runs as cloned.**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 與池內條目的關係**：[[chainladder-python]]、[[actuarial-reserving]]、[[reserving-ml]]、[[ibnr-app]]、[[gi-loss-reserving]]、[[loss-reserving-engine]]、[[motor-loss-reserving-dl]]、[[hgr-hidden-grammar-reserving]]、[[verified-reserving]]——**⭐ 而本條補上的是**「**先用庫核對到零差、**再用真實後續發展回測、**並把系統性偏差的成因與**低估方向**寫出來**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[chainladder-python]]、[[reserving-ml]] 應當並讀**；**⭐ 三點最值得借鑑**：**① 自寫實現先用**已收錄的庫**核對，**並把最大差寫出來**；**② 用**切掉一部分完整資料**的方式造回測**；**③ 結果**系統性偏一個方向**時，**去找**哪一步只靠了極少數觀測**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有運行該專案任何一步**（**未裝依賴、**未跑 `main.py`／`pytest`、**未複算任何發展因子或 CDF**），**不主張**其準備金數字、**不主張**其與庫的零差結論、**不主張**其回測百分比**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀任何原始碼正文**——**只讀** `README.md` **與 tarball 路徑列表**；**未打開** `src/` **六個模組、**`main.py`、**`tests/test_chainladder.py`、**亦未讀** `data/ppauto.csv`。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實** `data/ppauto.csv` **是否確為 CAS Loss Reserve Database（美國 Schedule P）某一公司、**某一段事故年**的切片**（**只轉述 README 說法**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實公司名稱是否確為 README 所述的 State Farm Mutual Group**；**⚠️ 該資料集的引用與使用條款**本次**未核實**。**⑤ ⚠️ **權利不明**：**未見 `LICENSE`，**README 亦未逐字給出許可條款****（**⭐ **這不等於**作者放棄權利**）**；**⚠️ 複用前須先取得作者許可**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實作者身份與機構**；**★0、**無 CI、**僅一個測試檔**——**⭐ 這是**個人練習級**倉庫**，**價值在**做法**而非可作生產工具**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核實 README 中「**$13.12M**」與表中 **13,122,496** 的對應關係**（**兩處均來自 README，**本詞條分開引用而未替它調和**）**。**⑧ ⚠️ 建立 2026-08-17 在解凍窗口之外、推送 2026-09-08 在窗口之內**——**本條的缺口是「先用已收錄庫核對到零差＋再用真實後續發展回測＋把系統性偏差的機制與低估方向寫出來」這一形態此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 本條目的任何數字**都只是**該專案在其自有資料上的自述結果**，**不得**用於任何真實的準備金判斷**。

e.body_en:
The repository loss-reserving-chainladder, by the GitHub user ishimwe07, **is a chain-ladder reserving implementation written from scratch in pandas**, described verbatim as chain-ladder reserving on a United States personal auto portfolio, validated against the pooled reserving library and backtested against nine years of subsequent development. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-08-17**, **last pushed 2026-09-08**, **zero stars**, primarily Python, **twenty paths in the extracted archive**, and **no licence file**, which this entry records as unclear rights. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the downstream using the upstream as a yardstick.**

**Verified information, all measured from the README and the file listing**: **first, the claim of correctness is turned into a quantified reconciliation**: verbatim, the ultimates are identical to the pooled library with a maximum difference of zero across all ten accident years, asserted in a test file. **Using an already pooled library to pin a hand-written implementation, and writing the maximum difference down, is better than judging correctness by whether the output looks plausible, and the baseline is named and asserted rather than implied.** **Second, what follows is not good news**: verbatim, the pattern matters more than the headline, every accident year is under-projected, not one overshoots, that is systematic bias rather than noise, and the error scales with immaturity, with mature years landing within a tenth of a percent while the least developed miss by about six tenths. **The measured numbers are a reserve estimate of about thirteen million against roughly thirteen and a half million actually required through 2016, a shortfall of about two and a half percent, with estimated ultimates of about a hundred and fourteen and a half million against actual of about a hundred and fourteen point eight six million, a difference of about three hundred and thirty-six thousand or under a third of a percent.** **This point is more valuable than the zero-difference reconciliation, because it separates an implementation being correct from the method itself being biased: the code can be entirely right while the reserve is understated year after year.** **Third, the mechanism of the bias is identified rather than only the number**: verbatim, the cause is that the later factors rest on very few observations, the last factor being estimated from a single accident year, and the comparison is made at lag ten so it excludes development beyond the triangle, which given that the last factor is still slightly above one means the true deficiency is somewhat worse. **Saying that the reported deficiency is itself an understatement is rare and worth copying.** **Fourth, every data choice carries its reason**: one company rather than the industry aggregate, because chain ladder assumes a stable development pattern that an industry blend does not have; paid rather than incurred, because incurred losses fall over time as case reserves are released, producing link ratios below one; and a cut at the 2007 valuation, because the raw dataset is a full square including actuals through 2016, so filtering recreates the real forecasting problem and the discarded portion becomes the backtest. **That last device, cutting a complete square and letting the remainder serve as the backtest, is the same idea as registering a prediction before the result is known.** **Fifth, the limitations are listed with the direction in which they change the conclusion**: no tail factor, so development beyond the tenth lag is treated as complete; the final accident year is highly leveraged, being one data point times a cumulative development factor of about two point two four while carrying half the total reserve; chain ladder degrades when claims-handling speed changes, when a single large loss distorts a cell, or when case-reserving strength shifts; and the alternative method that would address the leverage on immature years by blending in an a-priori expectation is explicitly not implemented. **Sixth, the engineering shape is countable**: six source modules covering triangle construction, volume-weighted age-to-age factors, cumulative development factors, ultimates and reserves, backtesting and plotting; a single main script that runs the triangle, the reserves, the backtest and the plot; a test suite for the library reconciliation; and a statement that the data is committed so that the repository runs as cloned. **Seventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover the official Python reserving library, several chain-ladder and Bornhuetter-Ferguson implementations, a pipeline that simulates and then cleans loss data, a comparison of classical methods against deep learning, reserving output discipline and a formal verification of reserving mathematics, **while this entry supplies reconciling a hand-written implementation to zero difference against a pooled library, then backtesting against real subsequent development, and writing the mechanism and the direction of the systematic bias into the limitations. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled reserving library and a pooled teaching implementation**, and **three practices transfer directly: reconcile a hand-written implementation against a pooled library first and write the maximum difference down, build a backtest by cutting a complete dataset and holding the remainder out, and when results are systematically off in one direction, look for the step that rests on very few observations**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no step of the project was run** — no dependencies installed, no main script, no test suite and no recomputation of any development factor or cumulative development factor — **so none of its reserve figures, its zero-difference reconciliation or its backtest percentages is claimed**. **Second, no source code was read**: only the README and the archive path list were read, and no module under the source directory, no main script, no test file and not the committed data file were opened; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, whether the committed data file is indeed a slice of the CAS Loss Reserve Database, United States Schedule P, for one company and a stated band of accident years was not verified, this entry relaying the README statement only.** **Fourth, whether the company is the one the README names was not verified, and the citation and terms of use of that dataset were not checked.** **Fifth, the rights position is unclear**: no licence file is present and the README gives no licence terms verbatim, **which is not the same as the author waiving rights**, and reuse requires the author permission first. **Sixth, the author identity and affiliation were not verified, and a repository with zero stars, no continuous integration and a single test file is a personal exercise rather than a production tool, its value lying in the practice rather than in its readiness for use.** **Seventh, the correspondence between the abbreviated reserve figure in the README prose and the exact figure in its table was not verified; both come from the README and this entry quotes them separately without reconciling them. Eighth, the creation date of 2026-08-17 is outside the thaw window while the push of 2026-09-08 is inside it**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap here is that reconciling a hand-written implementation to zero difference against a pooled library, then backtesting against real subsequent development, and writing a systematic bias and its direction into the limitations had no counterpart in the pool. Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that every figure here is the project own reported result on its own data and must not be used for any reserve judgement.**
